Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses two affinity purification methods (Co-IP and GST pull-down) to identify protein interactors. While the biological results discuss the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, the MS assay itself was a general AP-MS (Bottom-up DDA) and not a PTM-specific enrichment (like diGly/K-GG) for the MS analysis phase. PRIDE metadata explicitly states 'No PTMs are included in the dataset'.
